landing.title: Throughline
landing.tagline: The thread that connects every call.
landing.persona: Built for Marcus Webb and the Policyholder Services team — 50 to 70 inbound calls a day about billing, coverage, and policy changes. Throughline remembers what a caller already said, this call and the next one, so reps stop re-asking and start helping.
landing.feature1.title: Remembers the whole call
landing.feature1.body: A sliding window keeps recent turns verbatim; a rolling summary keeps the rest — so a detail from five minutes ago is still there when you need it.
landing.feature2.title: Recalls returning callers
landing.feature2.body: Structured facts persist across visits — a stated policy number or callback preference can auto-fill the next tool call, not just sit in a transcript.
landing.feature3.title: PII-aware by design
landing.feature3.body: Common identifier patterns are redacted before anything is stored or sent to a cloud model — and a real purge action can erase a case's data on request.
landing.feature4.title: Never silently overwrites what it remembers
landing.feature4.body: A conflicting fact is flagged for a human to confirm, not quietly replaced — the same discipline Threshold applies to payouts, applied here to memory.
landing.suite.eyebrow: Part of the Fenwick Mutual suite
landing.suite.body: Fenwick Mutual also uses Verity for claims research and Threshold for guarded claims-payout processing — three internal tools, one design system, one company.
landing.disclaimer: Fenwick Mutual is a fictional company created for this portfolio project. All caller and policy data is invented and does not represent real individuals or transactions. This is an internal representative-facing tool, not a customer-facing chatbot.

admin.memoryNoteBody: Turns beyond the live window are folded into a rolling summary rather than dropped. Redaction applies to persisted turns, the live Workspace sidebar, and anything sent to the OpenRouter escalation path — all from this one setting.
